rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Very steep, short side lane off a main road with homes 10 m away.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room to stop

drivers.seclusion: A dwelling sits 10 m away on the west side and a pool house backs onto the lane; homes on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Short sealed lane climbing from a main road; a car is already tucked at the foot and the rest is steep and tree-lined.
drivers.traffic: Main road at the mouth carries steady traffic.
drivers.convention: One car parked at the junction; no camping seen.

flags: Mapped gate 84 m away (not on the only access)
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tree canopy from the north and east.

best_section.where: Bottom of Palmer Street's side lane, just off the main road
